content.text: Acute spreading infect of deeper dermis & subcut tissues
Bacteria entry MC after a break in skin, ex underlying skin problems, trauma, surg wounds
RF: chronic edema, venous insufficiency, lymphatic obstruction, fissuring of interdigit 2/2 tinea pedis
later: fever, chills, malaise, lymphangitis, lymohadenopathy
skin bx only if IC w sus atypical organism
Variant of cellulitis involving the upper dermis & cutaneous lymphatics
Intensely erythematous, raised area w/ sharply demarcated borders
, or skin w/ impaired lymphatic drainage
